reasons.plausibility: It is consistent with known dislocation-mediated deformation mechanisms in high-entropy alloys, though the exact stacking-fault energy effects in FeNiCrMn remain somewhat uncertain.
reasons.testability: The proposed multiscale mechanical testing combined with in situ microstructural characterization directly ties mechanical response to dislocation activity and provides a clear path to falsification.
reasons.usefulness: Determining how temperature and strain rate influence fundamental deformation mechanisms in this Co-free system would be highly valuable for optimizing its performance under dynamic loading.
